messages:
Noah Rivera: Heads-up from QA: exporting from the 'Vectors preview' with filters applied returns unfiltered rows. Repro steps attached.
Sana Kapoor: Oof. That's confusing. Export should mirror active filters + sort. Users expect what they see = what they get.
Tom Becker: Backend currently ignores query state for export endpoint to keep it fast. We could send the current filter hash as part of export request so the server can re-run the query.
Jules Martin: UX decision: Show a small badge on the Export button when filters are active: "Export (3 filters)" and on hover show which filters. That reminds users the export is scoped.
Noah Rivera: Nice. Also, if the filtered set is empty, disable Export and show tooltip "No rows match current filters".
Sana Kapoor: Copy nudge: change modal title from "Export vectors" to "Export preview results" to emphasize it's tied to the preview pane.
Tom Becker: For formats: propose three options in modal: "CSV (metadata + preview)", "CSV + vectors (base64)", "ZIP (CSV + vectors.npy)". Default to first for safety.
Jules Martin: Accessibility note: the format radio group needs descriptive text: "Choose a file type. ZIP recommended for full embeddings." Use aria-describedby linking to helper text.
ux-bot: Accessibility check: ensure radio group has role="radiogroup" and keyboard arrow navigation works. Announce selected format changes via live region.
Sana Kapoor: Small UI tweak: add a checkbox "Respect table columns" that limits exported columns to those currently visible. Defaults to ON.
Tom Becker: Implementation: when checkbox ON, we send visible_columns param. If user toggles OFF, send full_columns=true. Server will validate column names and reject unknowns.
Noah Rivera: Performance constraint: server-side export for large sets should be queued and return a job id; show progress in the console notification center.
Jules Martin: Also propose a lightweight client-side export for <=5k rows that can stream to file without hitting the job queue. Faster for small work.
Sana Kapoor: UX microcopy: Primary CTA = "Export results". Secondary = "Advanced options" (expands the format and column toggles). Keep CTAs short.
Tom Becker: Logging: include export_source: "vectors_preview" and include filter_hash in audit logs for reproducibility.
ux-bot: Suggestion: add an ephemeral toast for keyboard users that says "Export started. Press Esc to cancel." Provide a cancel endpoint for queued jobs.
Noah Rivera: I'll update the prototype and add the filter badge + disabled state. Will try to keep the export modal under 600px wide for clarity.
Sana Kapoor: Thanks — please add acceptance criteria: 1) export respects filters & sort, 2) format radios accessible, 3) column toggle works, 4) small exports use client stream, 5) large exports use job flow.
Jules Martin: Looks good. I'll file DX-4195 and assign to Tom for API and Noah for mock updates.
Noah Rivera: Adding a quick screenshot to the ticket now. Thanks everyone.
